Hi Sam —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call so we have a shared picture: 

- Primary driver: reduce inference latency for real-time fraud scoring across payment flows.
- Current volume: ~450 reqs/sec peak, 50M tokens/month.
- Data concerns: PII filters in place, want customer data to never leave their VPC.
- Success criteria: P99 latency <120ms, predictable monthly cost, SOC2 evidence for procurement.

Based on that, I recommended two practical paths:
1) Hosted API (fastest to test) — good for proof-of-concept but may not satisfy data residency requirement.
2) Dedicated / Private (VPC or on-prem) — dedicated GPU pool with network isolation and KMS/HSM support; aligns with your data governance ask.

Attached are: Acme_MAP_v1.xlsx (mutual action plan), Redwood_VPC_onepager.pdf (VPC deployment overview), and an initial SOW_draft_v0.2.pdf (high-level scoping).

Proposed next steps:
- You: share any missing stakeholders (security, procurement, infra) — I noted procurement@acmeinc.com and legal@acmeinc.com on the call.
- We: schedule a 45-min follow-up with solutions engineering + security to walk the VPC architecture and answer SOC2/KMS questions.
- Timeline: rough estimate is 6-8 weeks to production for a dedicated VPC deployment once contracts and infra are sorted.

Are you available for a technical deep-dive next week (options: Tue 10am PT, Wed 2pm PT)? If priority/timing has shifted, let me know and I can adjust.

Thanks,
